evidence_anchors.evidence: Finally, let’s talk trends. Before the October Next Fest, I’d predicted we’d see just over 5,000 demos, which would continue the trend line. And… nope. Although some demos were pulled late, we still got to >7,300, up 66.6% (!) on June 2026’s ~4,400:

We use Steam follower increase here, since it enables us to benchmark to more Next Fests, and: a game in the top 10% of all Oct. Steam Next Fest titles added +63 followers (so +1,500 wishlists, maybe?), down 48% compared to June (+121 followers) and down 64% on Oct. 2025 (+173 followers.) That’s fairly representative of all tiers…

Part of the point here is - people already cared about these games way before Next Fest. (We estimate Frostrail already had 650k+ wishlists, for example.) But how many of you were following it closely? And that’s the point of Next Fest - it’s not a hype originator for most games, so much as a hype amplifier….
